notes.title: Xenoids update to version 0.25
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. Xenoids update to version 0.25 is already available.
In this update, new mechanics, items and enemies have been added to the game, balance and optimization have been improved, and known bugs have been fixed.

List of changes:
1) Added new effects mechanics. Now, under certain circumstances, a character can get a negative or positive effect affecting his abilities and characteristics.
2) A medic can now create Psychostimulants. Under the influence of these drugs, the character gains the temporary ability to see enemies through walls.
3) The Engineer now has access to the drawing of the Fire Turret.
4) The new Kamikaze xenoid. Explodes next to the character, applying the effect of "Toxic pollution" and leaves a toxic puddle.
5) The new Xenoid Spitter. Attacks from a distance by applying the effect of "Toxic pollution". Sets traps in the form of toxic puddles.
6) To remove the "Toxic pollution" effect, shower cabins are used, which can now be found on almost all decks.
7) When using the workbench in the observatory, resources from the storage are now available. There is no longer a need to move the necessary resources from storage to inventory first.
8) Now the outgrowth blocking the door can be destroyed with melee weapons and a kick. This solves the problem of blocking the only exit.
9) Added acceleration of scrolling the map when pressing the left Shift.
10) Solved the problem of a random shot when completing some puzzles.
11) The problem with the character popping out of the locker while typing in the chat has been solved.
12) Fixed a bug that caused the elevator to not work after loading the save in the online game.
13) Fixed bugs that caused text localization to fail in places.
14) Added French (Beta)
15) Slightly improved optimization.
16) Other minor improvements and fixes.

notes.title: Xenoids update to version 0.24
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. Xenoids update to version 0.24 is already available.
This update has improved balance and optimization, added new features and fixed known bugs.

List of changes:
1) Now, at an easy difficulty level, the amount of ammunition found has been increased, and first-aid kits restore more health.
2) At a easy difficulty level, the time limit has been removed in the story campaign.
3) A new item "Pouch" has been added, which increases the maximum number of portable items in the inventory.
4) Added the ability to skip the letter-by-letter text output by pressing the LMB.
5) Reduced mouse smoothing when playing with a first-person view.
6) The maximum storage capacity in the observatory has been increased.
7) Tooltips have been added to the main menu.
8) A legend has been added to the map (symbols with a description).
9) In the cooperative mode with "permanent death", the ability to resurrect dead characters has been added. To do this, the survivors must return to the observatory and reactivate the cryocapsules of the dead characters.
10) Androids have reduced strength and movement speed.
11) Memory cards no longer appear on levels when playing with unlimited saves.
12) Fixed a bug that caused disabling censorship to not work.
13) Several errors in the text have been corrected.
14) Slightly improved optimization.
15) Added German language support (Beta).
16) Other minor improvements and fixes.

notes.title: Xenoids update to version 0.23
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. Better Worlds continues to improve Xenoids based on player feedback.
Xenoids update to version 0.23 is already available.
This update has improved animations, added new effects and settings, and fixed known bugs and issues.

List of changes:
1) Added a selection of the difficulty level of the game.
2) The amount of resources on the map now depends on the difficulty level of the game.
3) Added the ability to set the number of revivals (up to 99).
4) Added the ability to view existing drawings when using inventory.
5) An engineer can now create items without using a workbench.
6) A small handicap has been added on the first visit to a new level so that players can get used to it without being attacked by xenoids (the handicap depends on the difficulty level).
7) Now only one drawer is available for interaction in tables with several drawers, which significantly speeds up the search process for items.
8) Added camera shake when firing a firearm.
9) Some animations of the character's movement have been changed.
10) Added animation and visual effect of using the first aid kit.
11) Added animation of interaction with drawers and cabinets.
12) Added animation of holding a large weapon without aiming.
13) Added animation of the nervous behavior of the character.
14) The animation of the melee weapon attack from the first person has been improved.
15) The animation of the kick from the first person has been improved.
16) Character movements and transitions between animations are now smoother.
17) Added the ability to disable the head shake effect.
18) Found blueprints are now added to all players.
19) The smoothness of player movement in the online game has been increased.
20) Fixed a bug that caused the statistics screen to not appear when a network game was defeated.
21) The option to disable censorship has been added to the main menu.

notes.title: Xenoids update to version 0.22
notes.notes:
Hello. Better Worlds is in touch.
I hasten to inform you that Xenoid has been updated to version 0.22. The changes made are based on your feedback. I ask you to continue to report problems found and give advice on how to improve the game.

List of changes:
1) Added the effect of swinging the camera when playing in the first person.
2) Added a screen shading effect when switching from first/third person.
3) Added speed effect when running.
4) Added aiming mode (Right mouse button by default).
5) Crouch are now switched (no need to hold the button constantly).
6) Stamina is now consumed slowly.
7) Workbenches, storages and computers are now marked on the map.
8) When interacting with the storage, buttons have been added to move all resources.
9) Added an option to disable the crosshair.
10) Added Bloom intensity setting.
11) Mouse sensitivity settings for first and third person are now separate.
12) Added the option to invert the mouse Y axis.
13) Fixed a bug with pushing a character into a drawer when closing it.
14) Fixed a bug with the issuance of a campaign completion achievement when losing.
15) Other small improvements and fixes.

notes.title: Xenoids Demo update to version d0.18
notes.notes:
Xenoids Demo has been updated to version d0.18
Changes:
- Transfer of the project to a newer version of the game engine.
- Changes in the visual design: more volumetric light sources, changed the fog effect, added an effect when using CCTV cameras.
- Improved optimization.
- Some interface sounds have been replaced.
- Changes in the balance.
- Fixed several bugs.

notes.title: Updating Xenoids Demo to version d0.16
notes.notes:
Xenoids Demo has been updated to version d0.16
Changes:
- Added the ability to select a region for a network game.
- Added 3 new items: automatic turret, mine and shock baton. Drawings of these items can be found at the location.
- Added new props to the location.
- Changed some character animations.
- Some interface elements have been changed.
- Improved optimization.
- Other improvements and fixes.

notes.title: Xenoids Demo has been updated to version d0.14
notes.notes:
Xenoids Demo has been updated to version d0.14
Changes:
- As a result of optimization, we managed to reduce the weight of the game by almost 3 times.
- Now enemies notice the player much faster if he has a flashlight on.
- Now you can play without the one-life mode.
- Added a more detailed description of the task.
- Added a hint with important keys on the loading screen.
- Small changes in the starting items of the characters.
- Other minor fixes.
